workdir.convention: A convention, not a permission: every bot can still read and write everything under /work, including a teammate's directory and worktree.
workdir.experiment: Each setting changes what the bots are told, so it is an experiment: compare it with a paired evaluation before relying on it. Runs already started keep the settings they started with.
workdir.intro: Where this workspace's bots start work, and how they keep out of each other's way in a shared git repository.
workdir.invalidRepo: Enter a path under /work, such as /work/app, using only letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-', and not under /work/bots.
workdir.laneNoticeLabel: Tell a run when the same bot is already busy on its other lane
workdir.repoHelp: With an own directory per bot, the platform prepares one git worktree of this repository for each bot, on branch bots/…. It never resets, pulls or merges a worktree; bots integrate their work themselves.
workdir.title: Working directories
